decisions.reason: As a recently launched and publicly presented industrial automation offering close to the firm's machinery domain, management is likely to continue backing it and attribute any early weakness to normal market ramp-up.

Although the web tool appears more peripheral and likely less asset-intensive than the firm's core machinery business, its recent launch and public listing still make management more inclined to retain it for another year than to withdraw it quickly.

This fouling detection system fits the firm's technical-industrial profile and, given the fresh investment and visible market commitment in 2023, management would usually persist rather than reverse course after such a short time.
